settings.title: Two cakes at 5am. One in the pocket for mile 20.
settings.body: 26.2 miles rim to floor and back. The gels stopped going down around mile 16; the cake did not.

settings.title: Ridge line, no bonk.
settings.body: A slow morning out and a fast one back. Half a cake every forty minutes and the legs stayed under me the whole way.

settings.title: The box before the bakery.
settings.body: Every batch is baked, cooled, cut and carried before it is packed. If it does not survive the vest it does not ship.

settings.title: Where it has been.
settings.intro: Notes from the road, the trail and the 5am kitchen. Kept short, kept honest.
